assessment: Alpha.554 fixes actual High9 ImprovedTerseObjectUpdate corruption: the old OGL dispatcher overwrote full non-avatar ObjectStates with pose-only placeholders, clearing real OpenGenesisLINK AttachmentPoint State, parsed TextureEntry and mesh metadata, and introducing unknown UUID-less phantom prims. A new region- and identity-gated WorldModel::apply_object_terse mutates only current recognized prim position and rotation, rejects unknown/stale/invalid/nonfinite/zero quaternion, prevents duplicate scene revisions and keeps parent, attachment, mesh, material and texture. Native regression proves all original fields survive, invalid/unknown packets are harmless; actual GL framebuffer pixels of a Firestorm skeleton attachment change following the preserved real WorldModel terse pose. Authenticated real NexVerse self avatar skin/outfit/COF and simulator-confirmed WASD end-to-end still open and unverified, weighted 38.65 percent (39 rounded).
